text.config.signed32.title: Signed32 Settings
text.config.signed32.option.expandWorldB: Removes the vanilla ±30,000,000 border limit and extends world bounds to the 32-bit integer range (±2,147,483,647).
Configures boundary limit (2^25, 2^30, or 2^31); chunk generation ceases beyond this threshold.
text.config.signed32.option.farLandsNois: Ports Beta 1.7.3 noise integer overflow to generate towering sky-high walls and swiss cheese caverns.
text.config.signed32.option.farLandsThre: Coordinate threshold where the Far Lands wall begins to emerge (Default: 12,550,821).
text.config.signed32.option.fartherLands: Coordinate threshold where the Farther Lands (Selector Noise overflow) begins to generate (Default: 1,004,065,920).
text.config.signed32.option.fixChunkOver: Prevents integer overflow during chunk-to-block coordinate conversions and removes vanilla chunk boundary clamps.
text.config.signed32.option.expandBlockP: Bypasses the vanilla 64-bit packed long limit (±33.5M blocks) using hash tables for full 32-bit integer coordinates.
text.config.signed32.option.expandSectio: Removes SectionPos 22-bit packing limitations, enabling section indexing beyond ±2,097,152 sections.
text.config.signed32.option.expandEntity: Restructures entity spatial indexing using hash tables, preventing entity drops or crashes at extreme distances.
text.config.signed32.option.extendedBloc: ⚠️ Requires Signed32 on BOTH client and server. Disable this when connecting to standard servers (Paper/Purpur/Vanilla).
text.config.signed32.option.cameraJitter: Degrades camera coordinates to 32-bit float, recreating the classic stepwise viewpoint stutter.
text.config.signed32.option.entityJitter: Snaps entity rendering coordinates to the single-precision grid, keeping entities in sync with world stutter.
text.config.signed32.option.blockTearing: Recreates vertex tearing and distortion on non-full block models (e.g., redstone wire, torches, rails).
text.config.signed32.option.jitterThresh: Absolute coordinate distance where visual stutter and tearing effects take effect (Default: 0).
